functions.name: json_parse
functions.doc: Parses JSON text into maps, arrays and scalars; fails on invalid or oversized JSON.

functions.name: json_stringify
functions.doc: Writes a value as compact JSON text.

functions.name: base64_encode
functions.doc: Encodes text as standard base64.

functions.name: base64_decode
functions.doc: Decodes standard base64 into UTF-8 text; fails on anything else.

functions.name: hex
functions.doc: Returns the UTF-8 bytes of the text as lowercase hex.

functions.name: sha256
functions.doc: Returns the SHA-256 digest of the text as lowercase hex.

functions.name: hmac_sha256
functions.doc: Returns the HMAC-SHA256 of the text under the key as lowercase hex.

functions.name: regex_match
functions.doc: True when the regular expression matches somewhere in the text.

functions.name: regex_captures
functions.doc: Returns the capture groups of the first match, group 0 first and () for a group that did not take part; empty when nothing matches.

functions.name: uuid
functions.doc: Returns a random UUID.

functions.name: random_int
functions.doc: Returns a random integer from low to high, both included.

functions.name: now
functions.doc: Returns the capture time as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

functions.name: replace
functions.signature: replace(text: string, find: string, substitute: string)
functions.doc: Replaces every occurrence of find in the text variable itself; call it as text.replace(find, substitute).

functions.name: pad
functions.signature: pad(text: string, length: int, padding: string)
functions.doc: Pads the text variable itself up to length characters with padding; call it as text.pad(length, padding).

functions.name: len
functions.doc: Returns the length of a string, array or map.

functions.name: contains
functions.doc: True when a string holds the text, an array the item or a map the key.

functions.name: starts_with
functions.doc: True when the text starts with the prefix.

functions.name: ends_with
functions.doc: True when the text ends with the suffix.

functions.name: trim
functions.doc: Removes whitespace from both ends of the text variable itself.

functions.name: to_upper
functions.doc: Returns the text in upper case.

functions.name: to_lower
functions.doc: Returns the text in lower case.

functions.name: split
functions.doc: Splits the text at every separator.

functions.name: sub_string
functions.signature: sub_string(text: string, start: int, length: int) -> string
functions.doc: Returns length characters of the text from start.

functions.name: to_string
functions.doc: Converts a value to text.

functions.name: parse_int
functions.doc: Parses a whole number; fails when the text is not one.

functions.name: parse_float
functions.doc: Parses a decimal number; fails when the text is not one.

functions.name: keys
functions.doc: Returns the keys of a map.

functions.name: values
functions.doc: Returns the values of a map.

functions.name: push
functions.doc: Appends an item to the array variable itself.

functions.name: pop
functions.doc: Removes and returns the last item of the array variable itself.

functions.name: print
functions.doc: Writes a line to the run log, 4 KiB in total.

variables.name: request
variables.doc: The captured request. Read-only.

variables.name: request.method
variables.doc: The HTTP method, upper case.

variables.name: request.path
variables.doc: The request path after the endpoint id.

variables.name: request.segments
variables.doc: The path segments after the endpoint id.

variables.name: request.query
variables.doc: Query parameters by name; the first value of each.

variables.name: request.headers
variables.doc: Request headers by lower-case name; the first value of each.

variables.name: request.form
variables.doc: Form fields by name; the first value of each.

variables.name: request.body
variables.doc: The body as text, the first 64 KiB; parse JSON with json_parse(request.body).

variables.name: request.ip
variables.doc: The sender's address.

variables.name: request.content_type
variables.doc: The request's content type.

variables.name: request.kind
variables.doc: How the capture arrived: http, email, dns or schedule.

variables.name: request.meta
variables.doc: Extra facts of the capture by name, such as the sender of an email.

variables.name: request.signature
variables.doc: The result of signature verification: valid, invalid or missing.

variables.name: request.capture
variables.doc: The capture.

variables.name: request.capture.id
variables.doc: The capture id.

variables.name: request.capture.seq
variables.doc: The capture's sequence number.

variables.name: request.capture.received_at
variables.doc: When the capture arrived, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

variables.name: request.endpoint
variables.doc: The endpoint.

variables.name: request.endpoint.id
variables.doc: The endpoint id.

variables.name: request.endpoint.url
variables.doc: The endpoint's capture URL.

variables.name: request.endpoint.title
variables.doc: The endpoint's title, empty when it has none.

variables.name: request.store
variables.doc: The endpoint's persistent variables by name.

variables.name: request.counter
variables.doc: The endpoint's persistent counters by name.

variables.name: vars
variables.doc: Run variables. Changes leave the script only through the returned map.
